reason: The text explicitly describes Yahweh's redemptive and protective actions toward the Hebrew people (Israel). Key phrases include 'You led in your mercy the people whom you redeemed' (נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ ז֣וּ גָּאָלְתָּ) and 'You will bring them and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance' (תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔). The entire song of praise celebrates Yahweh's salvation of Israel from Egypt, guidance to safety, and establishment in his holy dwelling, demonstrating that helping and preserving the Hebrew people is clearly one of Yahweh's goals.
